notes.title: The Majestic - Story Reveal Trailer
notes.notes:
Two sisters driven apart by grief and personal conflict. Your spirit takes the form of an eagle. Fly through magical lands and help them to reforge their bond.

Watch the trailer now!

[previewyoutube=1yruFc8uPoQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The Majestic continues the story originally laid out in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392780/The_Companion/]The Companion[/url]. This game will be much larger and is set to answer some of the more pressing questions raised from The Companion, as well as introduce new mysteries.

This is an ambitious title with a much larger story, more characters, larger maps, and a completely different playing experience, flying! Greater emphasis is being placed on visuals, sound and music.

My aim is to make games that are immersive, story driven, and thought provoking. This trailer is the first step toward revealing one of the larger themes for this game. But it is only a small sample of what is to come.

In the coming months I strive to complete a demo of the game, and I hope the full experience will be complete sometime in 2024.

Please stay with me as this project continues. You can follow my progress through the devlogs I put out on YouTube, through announcements here on Steam, and also through my Newsletter where I will bring every important update right to your inbox.

Join the Newsletter here: https://studio46.org/newsletter

One of the more significant ways to support this project is to please Wishlist the game. Indie game developers are constantly fighting algorithms and one of the surest ways to defeat them is with overwhelming support, wishlists, likes and follows.

Please Wishlist <3

Hey there! Welcome to my first devlog. I am developing The Majestic, an indie game that focuses on story, emotion, atmosphere, visuals and story. The Majestic will be a casual open world exploration game where you play as a majestic avian creature.

I am a solo developer and I am developing this game outside of a full time job and from family obligations. I have a wife, three kids and a dog who keeps me company in the late evenings while everyone is asleep. 

In this devlog I will introduce you to the current state of the game and I try to provide a roadmap for the future. In the future I will try to dive more deeply into specific elements of the game.
